svg.text: Pan & Lid Drawer Storage - nested layout
3/8" baltic birch; parts run along the 48" side.
Slotted parts (supports, rail inner plies) and divider B 3" tall; rail outer plies and divider A 4" tall; fingers and slots 1.5" deep.
Rows with fingers alternate with plain rows; 0.250" between rows, 0.500" padding at the ends of the stack and at least 0.25" at the ends of the rows.
Sheet 48" x 34": 2 x SUPPORT, 4 x RAIL INNER, 4 x RAIL OUTER, 7 x DIVIDER A, 7 x DIVIDER B, 4 x TEST, 2 x TEST FINE, 10 x LASER TEST, 7 x LASER TEST.
Cut order (cut file colours): 1 orange = laser test rectangles, 2 magenta = engraved labels, 3 red = dowel holes, 4 blue = fingered parts, 5 green = plain parts.
Test pieces (offsets engraved): 4 x TEST, slots and dowel holes -0.5 to +0.5 mm; 4 x TEST FINE, 5 slots -0.06 to +0.06 mm, no holes.
Layout check passed: no overlaps; smallest gap between parts 0.125" (min 0.125"), smallest edge padding 0.250" (min 0.25").
